summary.title: The First Council of Althane: A Campaign Two Epilogue
summary.synopsis: In the aftermath of defeating the Deep and the 13th Realm's crash into Ilkain, the Weft—now literal demigods—consolidate power across Althane. Noah delivers a sweeping full-campaign recap before the group settles into their post-adventure lives: Divex installs Oxus as head of the Trust and secretly assumes the Broker's mantle, Lev resolves Desmond's family situation and takes to the lighthouse anchorways, Dawn chronicles Althane and leaves technological gifts for Big Fish's people, and Henrik returns to Orsk to advocate for the common folk. The First Council of Althane convenes in Thyropae, where the party strong-arms the nations toward cooperation—teleporting directly into the Commandant of Orisk's office to force concessions. The session closes with a heartfelt graveside scene at Nils Bosco's headstone and the party testing their new one-shot characters in Færrin.
key_beats: Noah delivers an exhaustive, mostly-chronological recap of the entire second campaign—from the train robbery in Poleros through killing three gods, defeating the Deep at Ilkain, and the Crystal Point Lattice's departure from Althane.

The party discusses post-campaign downtime: Lev and Henrik want to resurrect Baron Ismert's daughter and Henrik's father Nils Bosco, but Josh reveals both souls are claimed by Nox (goddess of vampires) and cannot be revived without confronting her—an impossibility with no needles remaining.

Dawn travels to the Elber Pinnacle to finish Big Fish's unfinished work: he exercises the scattered remnants of Mandius (sabotaged by Aric long ago), allowing the first hunters' connection to the weave to slowly heal, and leaves magical tech blueprints with Big Fish's family as a generational head start.

Divex throws his weight around in Iliara, installing Oxus as the new head of the Trust to fill the vacuum left by the Crystal Point Lattice, and separately assumes the identity of the new Broker of the Network—unknown to all except Oxus, who is already in his debt.
Lev catches a level-six assassin hired by a disgruntled Teleros businessman, confirming the party's untouchable demigod status; no further assassination attempts materialize.

The First Council of Althane convenes in Thyropae with delegates from Corbai, Teleros, Iliara, the Gulch (Marzo), and a mushroom delegate from the Shimmering Isles; Orisk refuses to attend and Bravassing is consumed by civil war after all five council elders ceased to exist simultaneously.

The Weft teleports directly into the Commandant of Orisk's office—diplomacy (Lev 55, Henrik 40) and intimidation (Divex 32, Dawn 36) checks succeed. The Commandant refuses to join the coalition but permits the Weft to address the Nox situation and provides a list of non-First-House researchers; Lev's request for Cabal access is denied.

Post-council resolutions: Lev hunts rogue vampires, retires to a vineyard called New Haven with Yuri and their healed child, and becomes a ferryman on the lighthouse anchorways. Dawn takes a multi-year walking tour of Althane, chronicles everything, leaves Dawn engine notes with Marzo, and joins Lev mapping the lighthouse and establishing communication relays.

Divex orchestrates a power shift in Bravassing through Network contacts—placing an amenable leader in the vacuum—and founds X-Dive, a floating research city above Iliara combining resources from the Trust, First House, and Network, with his family in residence.

Henrik returns to Orisk to advocate for the working people and cure beast-plague victims with his divinity. He hosts the party at his mother's home, leads them to Nils Bosco's grave, reveals his light hammer bears the initials NB, and delivers a heartfelt speech about his father's belief in the spirit of the people.

The session closes with the party testing their one-shot characters (Combo the automaton monk, Mr. Pluckwort, and others) on the new Færrin Foundry instance, attacking each other to learn their abilities and encountering a level 25 creature called Tree Razor that turns them into trees.
items: Light Hammer with initials NB (Nils Bosco's mallet)
summary.cliffhanger: The campaign-two wrap-up complete, the party tests their new one-shot characters in Færrin—attacking each other and a level 25 Tree Razor—before scheduling the full one-shot for next Wednesday.
